statements.statement: CPT 93247 was ordered for the patient
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9, Z86.73)
The ordering clinician documented concern that intermittent arrhythmia may be contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion
The monitoring study is required to correlate the patient's symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
